description: Metadata/count-only readiness for Pennsylvania DHS listed Child Care Centers; not a facility acquisition connector.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Only the fixed portal policy, ajn5-kaxt catalog and center-only aggregate requests are permitted.
retry: No automatic retries; provider errors stop readiness without facility acquisition or API fallback.
checkpoint: Persist only a complete independently validated immutable preflight receipt. Retain complete notices and selected schema/aggregates, never raw catalog samples.
idempotency: Every explicit successful receipt publication uses a new immutable identity; no source/current pointer is replaced.
cancellation: Abort active transport and local pacing cooperatively. Publication is manifest/receipt-last; uncertain postcommit output requires inspection, not an automatic retry.
retention_profile: Internal metadata/count evidence and accompanying complete portal-policy fragment; no record-level exports or retained raw metadata caches.
